Q: Rebuilding 'build.ninja': subcommand failed A:

Delete the projectandroid/app/.cxx folder and clean the project.

I had an error like this in Android Studio. Seeing that it said that there was an inconsistency in the projectandroid/app/.cxx folder, I went to the file explorer, selected "show hidden files" and deleted that folder. I also cleaned the project. That was the solution for me.

Q: Displaying time duration and format properly A:

On your added calculated column, change the date type to Time (under the Modeling tab).

From there you can select different format options like hh:mm:ss though I don't think any of them will have the dd. part. If you need that, then you'll likely need to write a measure to format exactly how you want, in which case check out the FORMAT function.

Q: swiftui state based view switching isn't switching A:

@State only track value type changes in your case the problem is AuthService is class which is a reference type when userSession variable changes auth object remains the same and swiftUI does not render again when object changes, so you need to use ObservableObject and @StateObject to track the changes like below

class AuthService: ObservableObject {
    @Published var userSession: String = "" //This will track the changes when updates happen
}

Replace this

 @State private var auth = AuthService()

with

    @StateObject private var auth = AuthService()

or if you are using new Observation framework then keep AuthService same using @observable and just update below inside your contentView

@Bindable private var auth: AuthService
